lines.en: I do not hide; I walk straight at you.
The heavy steps are deliberate.
However fast you run, I walk as fast.
This body does not take detours.
I crush the dry branches underfoot.
The fog follows me and thickens as I go.
Now that you hear it, stop guessing.
I come straight through the trees.
I do not need to smell your direction.

lines.zh: 每走一步，就少一格距离。
lines.en: Each step takes one block off the gap.
I do not stop, and there is no need.
You will not finish this run.
I stand and let you move first.
The fog has not cleared and I am patient.

lines.zh: 你屋子的窗户对着这边。
lines.en: Your window faces this way.
I let my arms hang and wait.
Water runs somewhere far off; I stay.

lines.zh: 你藏在哪儿，我都等得起。
lines.en: Wherever you hide, I can wait it out.

lines.zh: 这一夜我只需要一个答案。
lines.en: Tonight I need only one answer.
The wind died and the fog clings.
I do not breathe, so you hear nothing.
You lit a torch; how bright.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得让我想笑。
lines.en: This quiet almost makes me laugh.
You count the time; I count you.
I know what is behind that door.
Come out, and I will not come in.
So you are finally willing to look at me.

lines.zh: 我的脸在雾里，你不用看清。
lines.en: My face is in the fog; no need to see it.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛红了，是没睡吧。
lines.en: Your eyes are red from no sleep.

lines.zh: 我盯你很久，你都没发现。
lines.en: I watched you long and you never noticed.
Raise the sword, but keep the hand steady.
Only one layer of fog lies between us.

lines.zh: 你的影子后面还有影子。
lines.en: Behind your shadow there is another shadow.
I look at you the way a hunter looks.
Retreat, and I close the distance.
Do not look back into the deep fog.
You are gasping far too fast.

lines.zh: 你认得我，只是不肯承认。
lines.en: You know me; you just will not admit it.
This look is your last one.
I do not mind being looked at like that.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高了，我还是黑的。
lines.en: You raise the lamp; I am still the dark.

lines.zh: 我站在你视线尽头，不动。
lines.en: I stand at the end of your sight, unmoving.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，我记住这一下。
lines.en: You blinked. I will remember that.

lines.zh: 雾贴在你背上，你还没察觉。
lines.en: The fog is on your back, and you have not noticed.
The fog is thickest right when I look at you.

lines.zh: 你不敢再抬头看我一眼。
lines.en: You dare not lift your eyes to me again.
A hit, and from you of all people.
That cut hurt, and it was foolish.
I have filed that blow away.
Half a step back, and I still follow.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，下一剑会偏。
lines.en: Your hand shakes; the next swing will miss.
Blood will not make me slower.
By dawn this wound will be gone.
Listen; my heart is still beating.

lines.zh: 杀了我，你只得到一滴眼泪。
lines.en: Kill me and all you get is one tear.
That one costs you three steps back.
I will not take what you hold out.
Food? I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 你把它扔了，我就踩过去。
lines.en: Drop it and I will walk over it.
I do not stop for bread.
Your hand is far too near me.
This thing will not hold me back.
You coax me with meat, like a dog.
What I see is your wrist.
Put it away; I do not want to see it.
I will not touch your bait at all.
You ran into me; there is no way back.

lines.zh: 我不让，这一撞你自己受着。
lines.en: I do not yield; you take the hit.
Shoved back two steps; find your footing.
My shoulder is harder than yours.
You are against the wall with nowhere to go.
The fog has no room for two.
That collision numbed your wrist.
Do not push me; it will not work.
That one counts as your move.
You pulled away; I am still here.
I do not need a second one.
There are none of my kind here.
Even your company would not count.
The fog clearing will not diminish me.

lines.zh: 我一个人的时候最清醒。
lines.en: I am clearest when I am alone.
A shadow has no need of a pair.
Stand there, and do not imitate me.
At night I take only one with me.
Company is a burden.

lines.zh: 天亮之前，我一直是一个人。
lines.en: Until dawn I remain alone.

lines.zh: 地上没东西值得我弯腰。
lines.en: Nothing on the ground is worth bending for.
What you drop, I do not want.
I walked over it and did not pick it up.
Let these things rot on the ground.
It is not objects I am after.
I will take your sword, afterward.
Bending down would only slow me.
This iron was in the way; I kicked it.
I have two hands for picking things up.
Right now I pick up only one thing.

lines.zh: 你出现的那刻，我就锁定了。
lines.en: The moment you appeared, I locked on.
No probing, only pursuit.
The fog barely rose and I am here.
Run, and you give me direction.
I do not need your face; this is enough.

lines.zh: 这一条路只有两个结果。
lines.en: This road has only two endings.
Your footsteps are the signposts.
I do not hide, and neither should you.

lines.zh: 从这一格开始，你被追了。
lines.en: From this block on, you are hunted.

lines.zh: 你回头那一刻，已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time you turned, it was late.
It is you I want, nothing else.
The gap is closing; you can hear it.
Your torchlight never reaches this side of the fog.
Tonight I hunt only you.

lines.zh: 你点了火，我就知道在哪。
lines.en: You lit a fire, so I know where you are.

lines.zh: 脚步声一停，我就到了门口。
lines.en: Your steps stop, and I am at the door.
I do not circle; I press straight in.
Your door shut; I will wait.

lines.zh: 墙也好，窗也好，都拦不住。
lines.en: Wall or window, neither stops me.

lines.zh: 你在门后数到十也没用。
lines.en: Counting to ten behind the door will not help.

lines.zh: 我听见你把箱子推过来。
lines.en: I hear you shove the chest across.
The dark arrives first; I follow.
Backed into the corner, just stay still.
I take the stairs two at a time.
Your gasping is getting closer to me.
The fog walks ahead of me.
Change direction and I change too.
You cannot leave those thirty blocks.

lines.zh: 我停在你门外的雪地上。
lines.en: I stop on the snow outside your door.
Only the last step remains now.
I am not fast. I simply never stop.

lines.zh: 你在楼梯上，我在楼下等。
lines.en: You are on the stairs; I wait below.

lines.zh: 你关门的声音，隔着墙也响。
lines.en: Your door shuts loud even through the wall.

lines.zh: 你绕到屋后，我已在屋后。
lines.en: You round the house; I am already there.

lines.zh: 我跨过栅栏，没弄出响声。
lines.en: I step the fence without a sound.
I do not know the path. I know you.
I strike and you cannot dodge.
This one throws you to the ground.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在我身上，没什么。
lines.en: Your sword bit me; it hardly matters.
Blood runs down from your collar.
I neither shout nor laugh.
Your grip loosens and the sword falls.
One more and you will not stand.

lines.zh: 我把你的火把踢进雪里。
lines.en: I kick your torch into the snow.
In this fog you cannot see the wound.
Do not beg; I do not understand it.
You will not walk out of this night.
Your knees give way first.
I am very quiet when I strike.
You fall, and the fog closes over.

lines.zh: 我一掌按下去，你还想挣。
lines.en: I press you down and you still struggle.
Once I touch you, you stop shouting.
I simply arrive, with no greeting.
This stretch is the place I chose.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我从林子边走进来。
lines.en: Night fell and I walked in from the treeline.
The moment the fog rose, I was here.

lines.zh: 你的营地有火光，很好找。
lines.en: Your campfire made you easy to find.
I wait for no hour, only for people.

lines.zh: 三十格内，我随时会消失。
lines.en: Inside thirty blocks I may vanish at will.
The night is long enough for the whole hunt.

lines.zh: 我从雾最浓的那处出来。
lines.en: I step out where the fog is thickest.
When you hear the branch snap, it is late.
The wind here is very cold.
When I appear, the birds stop flying.
I came to take one away.
A pity you chose to sleep here.

lines.zh: 我从不敲门，我自己进来。
lines.en: I never knock. I let myself in.

lines.zh: 你听见狗叫时，我已进院。
lines.en: When the dogs bark, I am already in the yard.

lines.zh: 我挑了个没有月亮的夜。
lines.en: I picked a night with no moon.

lines.zh: 火灭了以后，我就在门外。
lines.en: When the fire dies, I am outside the door.

lines.zh: 这里离你的床，只隔一扇门。
lines.en: One door is all that stands between me and your bed.
The fog has no road, only me.
The torchlight makes me squint.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，膝盖没弯。
lines.en: I land from the height without bending.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我照样看着你。
lines.en: Water floods in and I keep watching you.
The blast was loud; I did not flinch.
An arrow pins the corner of my coat.

lines.zh: 咒语在我身上烧了一下。
lines.en: The spell burned on me for a moment.
I eat nothing, and cannot starve.

lines.zh: 雷光里，你看清了我的脸。
lines.en: In the lightning you saw my face.
There is not even fog here.
